title: Tenant complaint letter
text:
Dear Mr. Castellanos,

I am writing about the heating in my apartment at 218 Alder Court, Unit 4B, Marrow Falls. Since November 3 the radiator has been cold. My neighbour Priya Venkataraman in 4C has the same problem. You can reach me at tessa.brightwater@example.test or on (555) 014-2290 after 6pm. My lease reference is LSE-90417.

I work nights at Harbourlight Bakery, so please leave any notice with the concierge rather than calling before noon.

Sincerely,
Tessa Brightwater

title: Community centre incident report
text: Incident report, Pinecrest Community Centre. On Saturday a volunteer, Marguerite Oyelaran, slipped near the pool entrance. She declined an ambulance and asked us to email her husband at j.oyelaran@example.test instead. Her membership number is PCC-3381-07. Witness: the lifeguard on duty, Tomasz Wieczorek, who lives two streets from the centre at 9 Orchard Mews. Mrs. Oyelaran said she would see her own GP, the Birchgate Surgery, on Monday.
